messages:
samir: Heads up — starting bring-up for lotus-embed-v1 (contrastive, 768d) quantized int8 per-channel. Need quick sanity: recall@1/5/10, cluster purity, UMAP drift on wiki + product-catalog holdouts. Ping @lia for eval harness. TL;DR: smoke run in staging.

lia: On it. Running the standard holdout sweep + longtail shard. Starting with 5k wiki queries. Will post numbers.

infra-bot: deploybot: model lotus-embed-v1 (tag: q-int8-perc) deployed to staging-nodes-3 — build 2026.03.20-5 

lia: Results (staging, 5k queries): baseline (fp16): R@1 0.712, R@5 0.898, R@10 0.934. lotus int8: R@1 0.705, R@5 0.892, R@10 0.930. delta R@1 -0.007 absolute. Latency median: fp16 12.3ms -> int8 9.8ms. Notes: high recall drop on short queries (<6 tokens) for category 'kb' longtail.

anya: Which quant backend? per-channel asymmetric or symmetric? And what nearest-neighbor index settings? HNSW ef/search?

lia: Per-channel asymmetric (scaling with zero-point). HNSW ef_search=128, M=16. Ran kNN on Faiss IVFPQ candidate set (nprobe=16).

matt: Can you paste the eval command? Want to reproduce locally.

lia: eval command:
```
python eval/recall.py --model lotus-int8 --dataset holdout_longtail.jsonl --k 1,5,10 --index faiss_ivfpq --nprobe 16 --ef_search 128
```
Also attached top-5 failed pairs sample:
- q: 'reset password ios' -> expected: internal doc id 23, got id 48
- q: 'price tiers enterprise' -> expected 312, got 511

jen: Small drop but latency wins look good. Can we try: per-channel+minmax calibrate + small bias correction (LOO on 10% holdout)? Might recover R@1.

lia: Yes. Starting bias-correct sweep (calibrate on val shard). Will post tuned numbers.

ci-bot: CI: recall-regression tests started for lotus-int8 against baseline (fp16). 18/24 jobs queued.

lia: Update (calibrated): R@1 0.709, R@5 0.895, R@10 0.931. Still -0.003 vs baseline. UMAP neighbor overlap (top-50) 0.88 -> baseline 0.91 (slight drift). Recommendation: ship as 'lotus-int8-v0.1-calib' to canary with auto-fallback to fp16 for R@1-sensitive routes.

samir: Agree. Plan: canary 5% traffic on search-prod, monitor recall@1 and error budget, auto-switch if R@1 delta <-0.01 for 5m. @matt can you add the rollout config? @jen schedule a follow-up A/B eval next week.

matt: Added rollout: route policy 'latency-priority' with max_canary=5% and fallback model fp16. Also added alert on recall_regress metric.

jen: I'll own the A/B. Will include query-length stratification + product-catalog subset. Setting meeting Thurs.

samir: :thumbsup: thanks all. Closing this thread — please drop any outlier examples in #eng-ml with prefix lotus-int8.
